name: Quick and Easy Vegetable Stock

ingredients.name: Sprigs of fresh parsley, thyme, or a dried bay leaf

instructions.primary_message: Peel and roughly dice the carrots. Roughly dice the celery. Roughly dice the onions. Smash the garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 medium carrots
4 stalks celery
2 large onions
4 medium cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot with 4 quarts of water and add carrots, celery, onion, garlic, and herbs. Bring to a low boil over high heat, then reduce to a simmer and let cook for at least 20 minutes and up to 40 minutes. Strain and use as needed.

description: Stock-making is often an involved process, requiring, at the very least, a special shopping trip and some simmering time. But when you can't put in that kind of effort, this basic vegetable stock will work wonders. It's quick and easy, and far better than store-bought vegetable stock or a flavorless alternative like water.
notes: Notes: In this recipe, the specific vegetables used and the amounts called for don't need to be strictly followed. Carrots, onion, and garlic, at the very least, are needed. Celery is good to add, as are leeks and fennel if you have them. No need to measure the water exactly, either: Just cover the aromatic vegetables with a generous amount, and this stock will come out fine.
author: Daniel Gritzer
